 Old Dominion University closes Batten Arts and Letters amid large first responder presence, cancels classes
 Prev 
 Next 
 WTKR 
 By: 
 WTKR Web Staff
 Posted 
 and last updated 
 NORFOLK, Va. — Old Dominion University has closed its Batten Arts and Letters building and canceled all classes there until noon Wednesday amid a large presence of first responders, the university said in an alert.
 University officials said there is no active threat to campus safety.
 Students, faculty and staff should avoid the area until the response is complete, officials said. Anyone nearby should follow all instructions from first responders and university officials.
 The university said it will provide updates as needed, or sooner if conditions change.
 This is a developing story, so check back with WTKR.com for updates. Email News 3 if you have info, photos or videos to share.
